name: Ruby Mandrake Heart
lore: The heart of a mandrake pulled at noon, before it can scream.
effect: You regain 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

name: Treant Heartwood Sap
lore: Sap tapped from a sleeping treant, with its permission.
effect: You regain 4d4 + 4 Hit Points.

name: Pegasus Heart's-Blood
lore: Freely given by a pegasus to those who saved its herd.
effect: You regain 8d4 + 8 Hit Points.

name: Ki-rin Mane Hair
lore: A single hair from a ki-rin's mane, shining like a sunrise.
effect: You lose all Exhaustion levels, and you are cured of all diseases and of the Poisoned condition. For the next 24 hours, you regain the maximum number of Hit Points for any Hit Point Die you spend.

name: Calcified Troll Marrow
lore: Marrow from a troll's thighbone; it twitches when left in the sun.
effect: For 1 minute, you regain 5 Hit Points at the start of each of your turns if you have at least 1 Hit Point. If you take Acid or Fire damage, this doesn't work at the start of your next turn.

name: Coagulated Unicorn Marrow
lore: Freely given by a dying unicorn — or so the seller swears.
effect: For 1 hour, you have 10 Temporary Hit Points and the effects of the Bless spell (no Concentration required).

name: Couatl Plume
lore: A feather from a couatl, a creature that cannot abide a lie.
effect: The creature that drinks it makes a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, for 10 minutes it can't speak a deliberate lie, and it knows it is under this effect.

name: Will-o'-Wisp Husk
lore: What remains when a will-o'-wisp gutters out: a hollow, glowing shell.
effect: For 1 hour, you shed Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. You can dim or restore the light as a Bonus Action.

name: Sliver of Cloud Giant Nail
lore: A sliver of nail from a cloud giant, hard as horn and twice as old.
effect: Your Strength score becomes 27 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is already 27 or higher.

name: Hill Giant Toenail Parings
lore: Collected, with great care, from a sleeping hill giant.
effect: Your Strength score becomes 21 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is already 21 or higher.

name: Purple Worm Gland Oil
lore: Lubricating oil from the gullet of a purple worm, sold by the bucket.
effect: Applied to a creature, it grants the effects of the Freedom of Movement spell for 8 hours. Poured on the ground instead (Utilize action), it covers a 10-foot square with the effects of the Grease spell for 8 hours.

name: Giant Spider Silk Gland
lore: Silk glands from a giant spider, wrung out over a vat.
effect: For 1 hour, you have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed and Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb.

name: Bulette Plate Shavings
lore: Ground from the armoured crest of a bulette.
effect: For 1 hour, your Armor Class can't be lower than 16, whatever kind of armor you're wearing.

name: Charged Roc Gizzard
lore: The gizzard stones of a roc struck by lightning in flight.
effect: For 1 minute, you gain the effects of the Haste spell (no Concentration required).

name: Pixie-Wing Dust
lore: Scales shed from pixie wings, swept up from a fairy ring.
effect: For 1 hour, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and can hover. If you're in the air when the effect ends, you fall unless something holds you up.

name: Blue Dragon Scale Dust
lore: Scales shed in a blue dragon's lair, still crackling.
effect: For 1 hour, you have Resistance to Lightning and Thunder damage.

name: Hippogriff Pinion Down
lore: Down from a hippogriff's wing, which still trembles in a breeze.
effect: For 1 hour, your jump distance is tripled, and you take no damage from a fall of 30 feet or less.

name: Distilled Basilisk Bile
lore: Bile from a basilisk's second stomach, where it digests stone.
effect: Applied to a Petrified creature, it ends that condition. On a creature that isn't Petrified, it grants Advantage on saving throws against being Petrified or Poisoned for 1 hour.

name: Black Pudding Spores
lore: Spores from the rim of a black pudding, sealed in wax before they can eat the jar.
effect: For 10 minutes, you have Resistance to Acid damage and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing; your worn and carried equipment comes with you.

name: Wyvern Stinger Venom
lore: Milked from a wyvern's tail. By eye, it is indistinguishable from a healing draught.
effect: A creature that drinks it makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 4d6 Poison damage and having the Poisoned condition for 1 hour on a failed save, or taking half as much damage only on a success. Magic that identifies it reveals it as a potion of healing.

name: Ochre Jelly Rind
lore: Skimmed from an ochre jelly that died of something else.
effect: Poured over a nonmagical lock, chain, hinge or set of manacles (Utilize action), it eats through the object in 1 round, destroying it.

name: Crushed Ghost-Cap
lore: A pale mushroom that grows only on the tombs of the restless.
effect: For 1 hour, you gain the effects of the Gaseous Form spell (no Concentration required). You can end the effect early as a Bonus Action.

name: Ground Banshee Bone
lore: Bone dust from a barrow where a banshee once keened.
effect: Once within the next hour, you can take a Magic action to wail in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in it makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 4d8 Necrotic damage and has the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn. On a success, it takes half as much damage only.

name: Darkmantle Ink
lore: Ink from a darkmantle's sac; it soaks up lamplight.
effect: For 8 hours, you have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet.

name: Shadow Mastiff Musk
lore: Scent glands of a shadow mastiff. Hounds refuse to follow its trail.
effect: For 1 hour, you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and your footsteps make no sound.

name: Vampire Spawn Ichor
lore: Drawn from a vampire spawn's veins before sunrise — never after.
effect: For 1 minute, once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a melee attack, it takes an extra 2d6 Necrotic damage, and you regain Hit Points equal to that Necrotic damage. Constructs and Undead are immune to this extra damage.

name: Crystallized Frost-Lotus
lore: A lotus that blooms only under a sheet of ice.
effect: For 1 hour, you have Resistance to Cold damage, you ignore the effects of extreme cold, and ice and snow aren't Difficult Terrain for you.

name: Sahuagin Gill-Fronds
lore: Feathery gills cut from a sahuagin, kept wet in a bladder.
effect: For 1 hour, you can breathe underwater, and you have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

name: White Dragon Gizzard
lore: Ice-hard stones from a white dragon's gullet.
effect: For 1 hour, you can take a Bonus Action to exhale frost in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in it makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d6 Cold damage and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. On a success, it takes half as much damage only. The effect ends after you exhale three times or when the hour ends.

name: Drowned Astral Lotus
lore: A lotus that grows only where the Astral Sea brushes the world.
effect: For 10 minutes, you have Truesight with a range of 60 feet.

name: Pickled Nothic Vitreous
lore: The single great eye of a nothic, pickled in brine and regret.
effect: For 10 minutes, you gain the effects of the Clairvoyance spell (no Concentration required).

name: Powdered Mind-Flayer Cilia
lore: Feeding tendrils of a mind flayer. The alchemist who sells them rarely says where they came from.
effect: For 10 minutes, you gain the effects of the Detect Thoughts spell (save DC 13, no Concentration required).

name: Crushed Ulnorya Teeth
effect: For 1 hour, when you take damage from a nonmagical source, you can take a Reaction to redirect up to half of it (round down) to a willing creature you can see within 10 feet.

name: Red Dragon Bile Sac
lore: The gland that feeds a red dragon's breath, cut out while still warm.
effect: For 1 hour, you can take a Bonus Action to exhale fire at a target within 30 feet. The target makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a success. The effect ends after you exhale three times or when the hour ends.

name: Salamander Tail Ash
lore: Ash from a salamander's shed tail, still warm a year later.
effect: For 1 hour, you have Resistance to Fire damage, and you ignore the effects of extreme heat.

name: Magmin Core Cinder
lore: The cinder left behind when a magmin burns itself out.
effect: For 8 hours, you ignore the effects of extreme cold, and rain and snow can't soak or chill you.

name: Chimera Heart-Ember
lore: An ember from a chimera's dragon head, carried in a clay pot.
effect: If you have the Frightened condition, it ends. For 1 hour, you have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

name: Dryad-Bower Moss
lore: Moss from a dryad's bower; birds nest in it uninvited.
effect: For 1 hour, you can cast Animal Friendship (save DC 13) at will without spell components.

name: Owlbear Heart-Feather
lore: A feather from an owlbear's breast — the only soft thing about it.
effect: For 1 hour, you have Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

name: Giant Beanstalk Pollen
lore: Pollen from a beanstalk that grew into the clouds overnight.
effect: For 10 minutes, you gain the Enlarge effect of the Enlarge/Reduce spell (no Concentration required).

name: Phase Spider Silk
lore: Silk spun half in this world and half in the Ethereal Plane.
effect: You have the Invisible condition for 1 hour. The effect ends early if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell.

name: Pixie Thimble-Cap
lore: A toadstool small enough to serve as a pixie's hat.
effect: For 1d4 hours, you gain the Reduce effect of the Enlarge/Reduce spell (no Concentration required).

name: Sphinx Whisker
lore: Plucked from a sphinx who allowed it, in exchange for an answer.
effect: For 1 hour, you gain the effects of the Tongues spell.

name: Blink Dog Fang
lore: A fang left behind by a blink dog — mid-bite, on the other side of the room.
effect: For 1 hour, you can take a Bonus Action to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. The effect ends after you teleport three times or when the hour ends.

name: Faerie Dragon Scale
lore: A scale from a faerie dragon, which changes colour as it ages.
effect: You regain one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower. If you have no spell slots, you gain Heroic Inspiration instead.
